item.title: Week 7: Network Analysis
item.description: Network analysis is all about looking at the patterns of relationships we find in our data, and seeing how individual ‘nodes’ are positioned vis-a-vis all the other ones, or what the emergent, macroscopic patterns might imply about how the entire population of …whatever it is you’re studying… might experience things like group identity or flows of information. We’re going to look at the entire Roman road network as represented in the ORBIS geospatial network model of the Roman world: https://orbis.
